title: Unity CLI Request Envelope
description: Unified request envelope for all CLI→UnityPkg bridge commands. Matches ALP-164 frozen spec §安全、性能与生命周期 / 统一 envelope.

requestId.description: Unique request identifier, e.g. 'req_01234567-89ab-cdef'. Generated by CLI; echoed in response.

instanceId.description: Target Unity instance identifier. Optional; if omitted the CLI resolves via instance registry.

dryRun.description: If true, the bridge should validate and preview the command without side effects. Only supported by tools with supportsDryRun=true.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. 0 or absent = use default (varies by command).
